question: Which launch vehicle has been approved by the Union Cabinet to support India's Bharatiya Antariksh Station and a crewed Moon landing mission by 2040?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Next Generation Launch Vehicle (NGLV)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Next Generation Launch Vehicle (NGLV)** has been approved by the Union Cabinet to support India's ambitious space missions, including the **Bharatiya Antariksh Station** (Indian Space Station) and a **crewed Moon landing mission by 2040**.
 
• The **NGLV** is being developed by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** as a reusable vehicle to reduce costs and improve efficiency for future space missions.
 
• This vehicle is envisioned to be a **three-stage rocket**, with advanced features such as semi-cryogenic propulsion systems for higher payload capacity compared to its predecessors like the PSLV and GSLV series.
 
• The **NGLV** will be pivotal in achieving India's long-term space exploration goals, including setting up **permanent human habitats on the Moon** and launching heavy payloads into space.
 
• The approval of the NGLV aligns with India's vision of becoming a global leader in space technology and exploration by leveraging advancements in reusable space systems.
